Now thanks to your hacking my trees to the ground there is not enough Truffula fruit to go around, and my poor Bar-ba-loots are all getting the crummies because they have gas and no food in their tummies.'"

But I had to grow bigger, so bigger I got. I biggered my factory. I biggered my roads. I biggered my wagons. I biggered the loads of the Thneeds I shipped out. I was shipping them forth to the south, to the east, to the west, to the north. I went right on biggering, selling more Thneeds. And I biggered my money, which everyone needs."

No one can sing who has smog in his throat.'"
